rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese way to say Saturday.

example.jyutping: sing1 kei4 luk6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 haang4 saan1

rows.note: Use this colloquial alternative when speaking casually about Saturday.

example.english: Are you free to have dinner together on Saturday?
example.traditional: 禮拜六得閒一齊食飯呀？
example.jyutping: lai5 baai3 luk6 dak1 haan4 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6 aa3

rows.note: Use this compact form mainly in written contexts such as schedules and notices.

example.english: The meeting is at three on Saturday afternoon.
example.jyutping: zau1 luk6 haa6 ng5 saam1 dim2 hoi1 wui2
